data.how_to_apply: College students can apply to volunteer for Splash! at Cornell. Volunteers help with program setup, registration, lunch, and clean-up. They receive free lunch and a t-shirt. Service hours can be provided. To moderate classes, volunteers must email the organizers to state their preference and complete additional forms including a background check.

raw.application_deadline_quote: You must complete the Cornell Child & Youth Safety forms by November 6th
